# Third-party source

* **Inter** typeface (Latin subset), SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `Inter/OFL.txt`. It is embedded in `Source/UI/EmbeddedFonts.cpp`.
* **JUCE 9.0.5** modules are in `../JUCE/` (AGPLv3 or a commercial JUCE licence).

All DSP is Epsilon's own code. Since v0.3, Voice uses its own TD-PSOLA shifter and YIN tracker, so the Signalsmith Stretch library is no longer included.
